Downtown Dubai

★★★★★4.8270 reviews

Downtown Dubai is a Middle Eastern restaurant in Malviya Nagar serving authentic Arabic dishes, including chicken shawarma, creamy hummus, mandi rice, kebabs, freshly baked pita, and falafel. Reviews consistently praise its rich flavors, customizable meals, and welcoming hospitality, while the compact seating makes it better suited for those prioritizing food over ambience.
